issues.description: Field mismatch for Animal.name: the problem statement UML declares the Animal attribute as type String (problem_statement.md, line 27), but the reference solution declares the field as private StringBuilder name (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java, line 4). This difference in the declared field type may confuse students about the expected attribute type and the intended getter/setter implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute type consistent with the UML/problem statement. Recommended: change the solution's Animal.name field to a String (private String name) and update the constructor, getter, and setter to use String. Alternatively, if StringBuilder was intentional, update the problem statement/UML to state name: StringBuilder and justify the reason for using StringBuilder.
